coordinator_decision.rationale: Coordinator accepts the bounded source contract and preserved variations in the attached source adjudication; provider disagreement is retained. No whole-function equivalence or human validation claimed.

verdict.label: separate
verdict.why: EXISTING is a large timeline virtualizer factory. It only calls observeElementOffsetReconnectAware (NEW) as its observeElementOffset adapter, so it delegates reconnect-aware offset observation to NEW instead of reimplementing it. Its other logic covers touch adjustment, cold-bottom settling, anchoring, resize batching, and row rendering. None of that repeats NEW's operations: the MutationObserver reconnect detection, the rAF offset re-check, and the live-scrollTop read once a scroll has settled. Shared names like scrollTop, isConnected, and observers are too generic to count as a common operation, and I found no reusable helper to extract.

provider_context_limit: Claude canonical shared-operations prompt includes full candidate code, not supplemental caller files. Jev uses bounded context; source worker/coordinator inspect callers separately.
